meta.title: WorkFlowPilot – Custom Business Automation & AI Agents

hero.subtitle: AI reads orders from WhatsApp and email, prepares a clear summary, and passes them to your systems only after you approve.
hero.trustLine: Nothing changes in your systems without your approval.

flow.ariaLabel: Animated demo of an automated order-intake process
flow.reducedDescription: Demo of an order-intake process: a customer sends an order over WhatsApp, AI reads the message and extracts the details (customer, products, quantities, date and address), the system checks those details against existing records, a manager approves the order over WhatsApp, the data is only entered into the ERP and CRM systems after approval, and finally the customer gets an automatic confirmation. The whole process takes about 12 seconds with no manual typing.

whyUs.title: Your business doesn't run on a template. Your automation shouldn't either.
whyUs.summary: We're not here to add another system to your stack. We make the systems you already have work better together.

custom.title: Solutions built around you
custom.description: Every process is built around how your business actually works, not a pre-made template.

businessFirst.title: Business understanding before technology
businessFirst.description: We understand the process and the goals first, then pick the right tools for the job.

integration.title: Connecting what you already have
integration.description: We don't replace what's already working — we connect your systems so they talk to each other.

smartAi.title: AI used wisely, only where it adds value
smartAi.description: AI is a tool, not the goal. It's used only where it genuinely saves time and improves accuracy.

humanControl.title: Human control and approval
humanControl.description: You decide which actions run automatically and which need approval first.

support.title: Hands-on support and rollout
support.description: We stay with you from launch, track performance, and keep improving over time.

commitment.title: Our commitment: nothing changes without your approval.

noChanges.title: Zero changes without approval
noChanges.description: No action is taken in your systems or data without prior, explicit approval.

yourRules.title: You set the rules
yourRules.description: Which processes run with approval and which run automatically is entirely your call.

minimalAccess.title: Minimal access
minimalAccess.description: Access only to what a process needs, with defined and documented permissions.

transparency.title: Full transparency
transparency.description: Every action the system takes is logged.

encryption.title: Encryption
encryption.description: Data is encrypted in transit and at rest.

confidentiality.title: Confidentiality
confidentiality.description: An NDA is signed before any work begins.

sensitiveControl.title: Control over sensitive actions
sensitiveControl.description: Payments, binding orders, and customer commitments always go through an approval step.

compliance.title: Legal compliance
compliance.description: We work in line with Israel's privacy law and data-security regulations.

systems.title: We connect the systems already running your business.
systems.note: Examples of systems we can look into connecting. Every connection is assessed on its own.
systems.message: You don't have to replace your systems. Sometimes all it takes is getting them to talk to each other.

howLong.question: How long does it take to set up an automation?
howLong.answer: It depends on the scope. A focused process can go live within a few weeks, while a more complex one connecting several systems can take longer. We'll give you a realistic estimate for your specific process in the diagnostic call.

howMuch.question: How much does it cost?
howMuch.answer: It depends on the process: its complexity, the systems involved, and the amount of work required. Pricing is set after a free diagnostic call, where we understand exactly what's needed.

replaceSystems.question: Do we need to replace our existing systems?
replaceSystems.answer: In most cases, no. We connect to the systems you already have rather than replacing them. We'd only discuss a replacement if there's a real gap that requires it.

aiMistakes.question: What happens if the AI gets something wrong?
aiMistakes.answer: Every process has control points and human approval built in where you need them, and any sensitive action requires approval before it happens. Exceptions and uncertain cases are flagged for a person, not run automatically.

dataProtection.question: How is my data protected?
dataProtection.answer: Data is encrypted in transit and at rest, access is limited to what's needed, and we sign an NDA before work begins. Every action is logged and transparent.

technicalKnowledge.question: Do I need technical knowledge to work with you?
technicalKnowledge.answer: Not at all. We handle the technical side. What you bring is knowledge of your own business process — we take care of the rest.

startSmall.question: Can we start with just one small process?
startSmall.answer: Absolutely, and it's usually what we recommend. Starting with one well-defined process lets you see results fast and learn before expanding further.

stopping.question: What happens if we want to stop later on?
stopping.answer: Your data and processes are always yours. If you want to pause or change direction, we'll hand everything over in an orderly, transparent way.

commitment.title: Our commitment to accessibility
commitment.body: WorkFlowPilot treats accessibility as a priority for all users, including people with disabilities. We work to align the site with Israeli Standard (IS) 5568 for web content accessibility, level AA, and with the international WCAG 2.1 guidelines.

features.title: Accessibility features on this site
items: Semantic structure, a valid heading hierarchy, and a "skip to content" link
Full keyboard navigation with a clear focus indicator
Screen reader support, including text descriptions for visual content and animations
Color contrast meeting AA requirements in both light and dark mode
A built-in accessibility menu: increase/decrease text size, high contrast, stop animations, underline links, and readable line spacing
Respecting the operating system's "reduce motion" (prefers-reduced-motion) setting
Full support for Hebrew (RTL) and English (LTR)

limitations.title: Known limitations
limitations.body: We continuously work to improve the site's accessibility. Some areas may not yet be fully accessible. If you run into any difficulty, we'd welcome you contacting us so we can address it promptly.
